_readme: DRAFT role cards. Rewrite freely. Prices are in thousands of dollars per year. Categories are used in the order listed: a small class uses only the first few. Every company name here is invented as a placeholder. Keep each id unique. Allowed assets: reference, security_cert, pilot_ready. Allowed priorities: lowest_cost, lowest_risk, fastest_deployment. Allowed constraint types: requires_proof (with proof), requires_pilot, min_savings (with pct), max_deploy_weeks (with weeks).
riskRule: If you buy from a start-up and it fails to deliver, you lose all your points. Start-ups with no proof fail more often.
projectorRules: Sellers: you have 3 offers. Find a buyer, negotiate face to face, then send the offer on your phone.
Buyers: you can sign 1 deal, or stay with your incumbent at zero risk.
If a start-up fails to deliver, its buyer loses everything. Choose who to trust.

exitQuestion.seller: Why do you think you won or lost?
